A trash mob (or simply trash) is any mob that is not a boss. Trash mobs are usually easier to kill than bosses, although there are some famous trash pulls which are actually harder than the boss they precede (a more recent example would be the opening pulls of Bastion of Twilight which has two patrols that are inter-meshed with each other). Players usually don't like trash mobs since they are viewed as a tedious and time-consuming preamble to boss fights. Nonetheless, trash mobs in instances usually give reputation and have some useful drops, frequently some crafting material which cannot be obtained otherwise. Travis Day, also known as Indalamar, is a former senior game designer for Diablo III. He previously worked as a game designer for Diablo III: Reaper of Souls. His first position as a game designer was as a member of the World of Warcraft team, handling item design duties. He announced on July 11, 2018, that he decided to start a new adventure after 13 years with Blizzard. He passed away on August 10th, 2022, at the age of 41.

Traphands were invented by an orc tinker after his brother lost both hands to a trunk trapped with a gunpowder charge. The operator of a pair of traphands sticks his hands into gauntlet-like holes in the side of the device. By moving her hands, the operator controls the movement of hands mounted on long arms that can be extended up to 15 feet from the device. Traphands are deft enough to allow the use of lockpicks and thieves' tools. Though they have a mailed exterior in an attempt to resist damage inflicted by acid, needles and other traps, the delicate machinery in the hands is prone to malfunction. Pressure plates, razor traps and needles in locks are all rapid routes to a quick demise or at least substantial personal injury. When stealth isn't an issue and time is abundant, the trap thumper is the best way to check a hallway, door or lock to trigger any countermeasures left for the unwary. The trap thumper resembles a spring-loaded, 3-foot-tall, heavy leather bag with two short feet. The device also has an armature probe for checking locks. Winding the trap thumper sets it into one of three modes. Trapper's Delight is an achievement earned from completing 250 work orders at the Barn in the garrison.
Transponder 047-B starts the profession quest line for engineers to unlock 700 skill and the Engineering Works for your garrison.
Traveller Pepe is a Pepe bird with goggles on found in Dalaran.
Trashy Jr. can be found in the Circle of Wills in Dalaran. He is likely the son of Trashy.
Trapped Treasure Chest Kit is a reputation reward; you must be with The Wardens to purchase this item from Marin Bladewing in Azsuna for . It summons an Innocent Looking Treasure Chest.
Treads of the Depraved drops from the Maiden of Virtue in the Return to Karazhan.
__NOTOC__ Treads of the Drowned drop from Helya in Trial of Valor.

Trashy is a raccoon that wanders around Margoss's Retreat in Dalaran, occasionally swimming through the pond, climbing on the rocks, jumping up on the roof of the fishing hut or sitting down to defecate next to some barrels. He is likely the parent of Trashy Jr. in the Underbelly.
__NOTOC__ Treant Sapling is a treant located in the Dreamgrove after researching Ancient of War (advancement). It tends to and trains ancients of war.
Traveling Traders are pandaren located in New Cifera and the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds. Sturdy Yaks are be pulling their carts.
__NOTOC__ Trapped Silver Hand Knights must be rescued on Niskara.

Treasure Master Iks'reeged is a wyrmtongue seen at various locations on the Broken Shore. Although, as the quests with Excavator Karla progresses, Iks'reeged eventually winds up imprisoned within the Secret Treasure Lair, where all the Treasure Master's wealth can be found.
Treasures of Azsuna is an exploration achievement earned from looting 35 treasures in Azsuna. Veridis Fallon sells Treasure Map: Azsuna, which shows treasure locations on the minimap.
The Traveling Karabor Citizen is a sleeping draenei located in the Silken Pillow in Elodor in .
Traveler: The Spiral Path is a World of Warcraft novel continuing the adventures of young Aramar Thorne, son of famous explorer Captain Greydon Thorne, where the first book, Traveler, left off.
Trapped Wolves are wolves that can be found at the burning kennel south of Far Watch Post in the Northern Barrens. They are chained and can't flee by themselves.
__NOTOC__ Travis Daybreak is a human located at the Carver's Harbor in Drustvar.
__NOTOC__ Treasure Hunting Buccaneers are humans located at Land's End Beach in Tanaris.
__NOTOC__ Treasure Hunting Pirates are humans, Dark Iron dwarves, and goblins located at Land's End Beach in Tanaris.
__NOTOC__ Treasure Hunting Swashbucklers are humans, goblins, and Dark Iron dwarves located at Land's End Beach in Tanaris. They are Southsea Swashbucklers.
Treadward's Ring is looted from Forgotten Bones or a Skeleton in Drustvar for Painful Memories and is provided as an objective for One Last Request.
Treant Spirits are treant ghosts located at Irontree Woods in Felwood, summoned by the Flute of the Ancients.
Traveler Nali is a jinyu located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Traveling Adventurers are located in Axefall and Southport in Spires of Arak.
Treads of Creeping Shadows drop from Mephistroth in the Cathedral of Eternal Night.
Travel Beasts are direhorns located at the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor and in Scaletrader Post in Zuldazar. They look like the Palehide Direhorn mount. Another one appears in Nazmir.
Treads of Sand and Blood drops from Kargath Bladefist in Highmaul.

Treasure Maps can spawn on the ground or on walls in various locations around the Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun, with a roughly 15-minute respawn timer. Interacting with one grants the Thirst for Treasure buff for 10 minutes.
Traveler's Banking Chest is looted from Treasure Chest in Withered Army Training in Suramar.
Trapped Tortollans are tortollans located in Stormsong Valley.
The Treads of the Receding Nightmare are a quest reward from Darkheart Thicket: Enter the Nightmare.

Traveler: The Shining Blade is a World of Warcraft novel written by Madeleine Roux. As the third and final book in the Traveler series, the book continues the adventures of young Aramar Thorne, son of famous explorer Captain Greydon Thorne, and his friends. It was released on December 26, 2019.
Trapped Soul Warmace is a quest reward from Zandalari Treasure Trove.
Trapped Soul Warstaff is a quest reward from Zandalari Treasure Trove.
Trapped Kodo are kodo found in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore during the Heritage of the Shu'halo.
Trashmaster's Mantle drops from K.U.-J.0. in Operation: Mechagon. Equipping this cloak applies the Trashmaster title.
Treasure Map: Chain of Events is a mission granted after using the Treasure Map of The Dread Chain.
